thread:
kevin.choi: Morning — quick async standup for GW/routing/auth/rate-limits. Did: rolled canary 3 to staging, ran load test. Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s against /v1/generate from staging harness. Today: investigate, rollback if needed. @lina.s any insight? :eyes:

lina.s: saw that too. Logs show sudden jump in concurrent streams from test-harness-2 around 07:12 UTC. Traces point to missing `x-rw-client` header after passthrough. Adding logs now.

omar.p: pushed a small header-propagation patch in PR #3421. Needs review — I couldn't repro locally but tracing in staging matches. cc @sara.m

sara.m: looking. Can you paste the minimal repro curl?

omar.p: sure — here's what the harness hits (staging):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hi"}' \
  https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Also routing JSON we used:
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","backend":"gen-v2-canary","policies":["auth","rate_limit"]}
```

sara.m: looking at logs — the canary backend returns 200 but GW returns 429 shortly after, likely rate-limiter double-counting when KV cache misses. Reproduced with 100 concurrent streams. Working on a patch to dedupe counts.

kevin.choi: ok please ping when you have a rollback readiness check. If it's >5% errors we rollback to gen-v1 pool. @deploy-bot what was the canary rollout percentage?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed to 10% of traffic at 2025-11-01T07:05:23Z. No automatic rollback triggered.

lina.s: added ephemeral debug flags to staging (gw:rate_debug=true). Leaving on for 30m.

omar.p: PR updated with a guard to avoid double-increment, added unit test. Link: https://git.redwood/omar/pull/3421 :thumbsup:

sara.m: quick question — will dedupe affect dedicated customers with client-ids? need to scope by `x-customer-id`.

omar.p: yep scoped by header. If header missing we fallback to src-ip sharding.

kevin.choi: plan: hold canary for 1hr, monitor 429 rate and latency. If error rate >3% for 5m or p95 latency >600ms we'll rollback. I'll update the incident playbook after.

sara.m: ack. I'll watch graphs and post updates here. :eyes:

lina.s: if anyone needs logs: `kubectl logs -f gw-xxxx -n staging --tail=200 | grep rate-limiter`

kevin.choi: thanks all. short follow-ups later.
